propositions: The plan-review criterion project.portability has an undifferentiated CI matrix cell that fails to nameably distinguish capabilities that hard-depend on a specific CI provider from projects with no CI provider at all.

A capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule) with no operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and should be detected as a finding that names the no-CI-provider alternate shape.

The authoritative detection text in .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md must be extended with a split matrix cell naming both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all', plus a rule stating the hard-dependency constraint.
Hand-authored mirrors in docs/plan-review-gate.md and their pinned test assertions must be kept synchronized with the authoritative rubric wording to prevent silent drift.

Live A/B efficacy testing confirms that a GitHub-Actions-only compaction schedule with no fallback fires a project.portability finding post-change and zero findings pre-change, proving the rule detects the gap it closes.
